portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure that all previously-released
errata relevant to your system have been applied.

This update is available via Red Hat Network.  Details on how to use
the Red Hat Network to apply this update are available at
http://kbase.redhat.com/faq/FAQ_58_10188
portal_description:
Metacity is a simple window manager that integrates with GNOME 2.

A bug in metacity caused applications using "gtk_window_present()", and
startup notifications, to jump between workspaces. For example, if Mozilla
Firefox was opened on workspace two, and then a web URL was clicked-on in
the current workspace, Firefox jumped to the current workspace.

Users of metacity are advised to upgrade to this updated package, which
resolves this issue.
